verdict.rationale: The documented API covers most core workflows. Docs explicitly say cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either in the Mesh web app or via the API. The API also covers screening (sync, async and batch), monitoring configuration, exports, case audit trails, roles, transaction processing and webhooks, and a retrievable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema confirms customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources. However, nothing states full UI parity, and API credentials themselves are generated in the web app. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API evidence for credential management, API evidence for configuring the risk-score equation and screening configurations, and independent hands-on verification of coverage.
